technical.summary: LULU shows early oversold bounce signals (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up) but lacks conviction with price below all key moving averages, negative MACD, and death cross—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 23 days create a low-conviction environment with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (195+ days old); no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and earnings in 23 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for discretionary equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI rising + StochRSI cross-up + Supertrend bullish signal early oversold bounce potential with extreme fear (14/100) offering contrarian opportunity near support at 284.79.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, EMA death cross, negative MACD, Ichimoku below cloud, VIX crisis (432.88), imminent earnings (23 days), and unfavorable macro (rising DXY, flat yield curve) create insufficient confluence and excessive event risk for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Early oversold bounce signals (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up) present contrarian opportunity in extreme fear environment, but insufficient technical confluence and adverse macro backdrop do not justify entry risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (432.88), earnings event in 23 days, and price below all major moving averages create compounding event and macro risk that outweighs early bounce signals.
